about.title: The Pomodoro Technique
about.text: (meaning 'tomato' in Italian) is a globally renowned method for time management and enhancing productivity and focus, invented by Italian developer Francesco Cirillo in the late 1980s. The concept involves breaking work or study time into short, defined intervals separated by brief breaks, thereby preventing mental fatigue and maintaining peak levels of concentration and energy.

howAppWorksSection.answr: The app checks the status of each item every minute and sends notifications accordingly. Once midnight strikes and the day ends, any uncompleted (pending) items are automatically reclassified as 'completed' and moved to the completed items section; the day's final result is then recorded and saved in the statistics section for review of daily and weekly performance.

howCanHelpMeSection.ques: How the application can help you
howCanHelpMeSection.answr: The app can help you study your subjects and manage your time for you, and give you a lot of helpful tools to make the study faster, for example: Timer, Pomodoro, Statistics, and more. the app sends an alert when the time of the subjects is drawing near, and sorts the subjects by status or any custom preference.
